f.title: All industry must report through e-Reporting Industria (XML upload or manual module)
f.statement: Eventually and in the short term, as access is granted, all industry must use the e-Reporting Industria platform, which has two modules: XML upload and manual data entry.
f.clause: 1. Generalidades

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Eventualmente y en un corto plazo (conforme se vayan otorgando accesos), toda la industria deberá utilizarla plataforma e-Reporting Industria, la cual consta de 2 (dos) módulos: Módulo de carga de XML y Módulo de carga manual de información.
rows.location: 1. Generalidades
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Eventually and in the short term (as access is granted), all industry shall use the e-Reporting Industria platform, which consists of 2 (two) modules: XML upload module and manual information entry module.

f.title: Perform all actions on externally generated E2B XML reports through the E2B upload module
f.statement: All actions on XML reports created in databases external to e-Reporting Industria (initial cases, follow-ups, nullifications, etc.) must be performed through the CARGAR E2B module.
f.clause: 1.1. Módulo de carga de XML

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Todas las acciones con reportes XML creados en bases de datos externas a eReporting industria se deben realizar a través del módulo CARGAR E2B (envío de casos iniciales, seguimientos, nulificaciones etc.).
rows.location: 1.1. Módulo de carga de XML
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: All actions with XML reports created in databases external to eReporting industria must be carried out through the CARGAR E2B (upload E2B) module (sending of initial cases, follow-ups, nullifications, etc.).

f.title: Comply with current regulations whichever reporting module is used
f.statement: Regardless of the module used, compliance with what is required by the current regulations is indispensable.
f.clause: 1.2. Módulo de carga manual de información

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Independientemente del módulo que utilice la industria farmacéutica, es indispensable el cumplimiento de lo solicitado en la Reglamentación actual vigente.
rows.location: 1.2. Módulo de carga manual de información
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Regardless of the module used by the pharmaceutical industry, compliance with what is required in the current Regulations is indispensable.

f.title: Do not submit test cases through either module
f.statement: Test cases must not be entered through either module, since they would reach the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV) database as valid cases, unless DINAVISA indicates otherwise.
f.clause: 3.1. Indicaciones iniciales

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: No ingresar casos de prueba por ninguno de los módulos, ya que estos llegarían a la base de datos del CNFV como casos válidos, salvo indicación de DINAVISA.
rows.location: 3.1. Indicaciones iniciales
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Do not enter test cases through either module, since they would reach the CNFV database as valid cases, unless DINAVISA indicates otherwise.

f.title: Keep the PV responsible person designation up to date to obtain accounts
f.statement: To be granted accounts, the designation of the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person (RFV) with the Pharmacovigilance Department must be up to date, since e-mail communication is exclusively with the RFV and deputy (if applicable). Designation rules are in Resolution S.G. No. 050/16 and the designation form.
f.clause: 3.2. Solicitud de cuentas de usuario

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Para el otorgamiento de cuentas es fundamental tener actualizada la designación del Responsable de Farmacovigilancia (RFV) ante el Dpto. de Farmacovigilancia, ya que la comunicación por correo electrónico será exclusivamente con el/la responsable y adjunto (si aplica). Las disposiciones de designación de Responsable de Farmacovigilancia se encuentran establecidas en la Resolución S.G.Nº 050/16 y en la Ficha de designación, ambas disponibles en la página web de la DINAVISA.
rows.location: 3.2. Solicitud de cuentas de usuario
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the contiguous passage so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For the granting of accounts it is essential to have the designation of the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person (RFV) up to date with the Pharmacovigilance Department, since e-mail communication will be exclusively with the responsible person and deputy (if applicable). The provisions on designation of the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person are set out in Resolution S.G. No. 050/16 and in the Designation Form, both available on the DINAVISA website.

f.title: Use corporate or institutional e-mail addresses for user accounts
f.statement: The e-mail addresses of e-Reporting Industria users must be corporate or institutional.
f.clause: 3.2. Solicitud de cuentas de usuario

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Indispensable que los correos de los usuarios sean corporativos o institucionales.
rows.location: 3.2. Solicitud de cuentas de usuario
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: It is indispensable that users' e-mail addresses are corporate or institutional.

f.title: Request account changes with the new responsible person's designation
f.statement: To modify accounts (for example on a change of Regent/Technical Director or RFV), the company must request it by e-mail with the designation and the information of the new account holder.
f.clause: 3.2. Solicitud de cuentas de usuario
f.processes: Safety system configuration; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Para modificación de cuentas, por ejemplo, por cambio de Regente/DT/ Responsable de Farmacovigilancia, debe solicitarlo al correo arriba señalado con la Designación e información del responsable de la nueva cuenta.
rows.location: 3.2. Solicitud de cuentas de usuario
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To modify accounts, for example due to a change of Regent/Technical Director/Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person, it must be requested at the e-mail address indicated above with the Designation and information of the person responsible for the new account.

f.title: Each laboratory is responsible for renewing its MedDRA licence
f.statement: Each laboratory is responsible for renewing, or verifying the renewal of, its organisation's MedDRA licence with MSSO in order to use the terminology legally in e-Reporting Industria.
f.clause: 3.5. Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Exención de responsabilidad: cada laboratorio es responsable de realizar/verificar la renovación de la licencia MedDRA de su organización con MSSO, para poder utilizar la terminología en e-Reporting Industria de forma legal.
rows.location: 3.5. Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Disclaimer: each laboratory is responsible for carrying out/verifying the renewal of its organisation's MedDRA licence with MSSO, in order to use the terminology in e-Reporting Industria legally.

f.title: Use of MedDRA is recommended for both upload modules
f.statement: Incorporating and using the MedDRA dictionary is recommended for both upload modules.
f.clause: 3.5. Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Se recomienda la incorporación y utilización del diccionario MedDRA para ambos módulos de carga.
rows.location: 3.5. Administración y activación de licencia MedDRA
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The incorporation and use of the MedDRA dictionary is recommended for both upload modules.

f.title: Download ackLogs promptly; the sender is responsible for keeping them (35-day availability)
f.statement: The ackLog must be downloaded as soon as possible after uploading the XML, since the system keeps only 35 days of history and it cannot be downloaded afterwards. The sender is responsible for keeping a backup of the ackLogs, which the Pharmacovigilance Department cannot regenerate once deleted from the history.
f.clause: 3.8. Módulo Carga de XML

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Es fundamental que descargue el ackLog lo más pronto posible una vez cargado el XML, ya que el sistema solo podrá guardar el histórico de 35 días previos. Una vez pasado este límite, ya no podrá descargar el ackLog. Es responsabilidad del emisor tener respaldo de los ackLog generados, ya que elDpto. de Farmacovigilancia no podrá generar nuevamente ackLog una vez que se eliminen del histórico.
rows.location: 3.8. Módulo Carga de XML
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: It is essential that you download the ackLog as soon as possible once the XML is uploaded, since the system can only keep a history of the previous 35 days. Once this limit has passed, you will no longer be able to download the ackLog. It is the sender's responsibility to keep a backup of the ackLogs generated, since the Pharmacovigilance Department cannot generate the ackLog again once deleted from the history.

f.title: Use nullFlavor codes only when the field is mandatory for submission
f.statement: NullFlavor (NF) codes may only be used to withhold a field's information when the system requires that field to send the report; if the information is unavailable and the field is not mandatory, it can be left blank with the preset NF marker.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual (códigos NF)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Cabe señalar que estos códigos sólo podrán tener justificación de uso para no aportar la información del campo si el sistema requiere obligatoriamente llenar ese campo para poder enviar el reporte al Dpto. de Farmacovigilancia. Si en un campo que contiene un código NF, no se cuenta con la información y esta no es obligatorio para el envío del reporte puede dejarlo en blanco y dejar el marcador en NF prestablecido. Por ejemplo: Start of reaction /event (Fecha de inicio de la reacción /evento); dado que no es un criterio mínimo para la notificación, el campo puede quedar en blanco con el marcador NF.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual (códigos NF)
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the contiguous passage so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: It should be noted that these codes may only be justifiably used to not provide the field information if the system mandatorily requires that field to be filled in to send the report to the Pharmacovigilance Department. If in a field containing an NF code the information is not available and it is not mandatory for sending the report, you may leave it blank and leave the preset NF marker. For example: Start of reaction/event; since it is not a minimum criterion for notification, the field may be left blank with the NF marker.

f.title: Literature cases: add the bibliographic reference; do not use "Not available to sender"
f.statement: For literature cases, the bibliographic reference from which the case was obtained must be added in the Literature references field; if the origin of the literature report is unclear, the "Other" option must be chosen, and the option "Not available to sender" must not be used.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Tipo de reporte

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Además, deberá agregar necesariamente la referencia bibliográfica de donde se obtuvo el caso colocándola en el campo Literature references (Referencias de literatura). Ver Literature reference. Si no es clara la procedencia del reporte de literatura debe elegir la opción “Other” (otro). La opción “Not available to sender” (no disponible para el remitente) no debe ser utilizada.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Tipo de reporte
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In addition, the bibliographic reference from which the case was obtained must necessarily be added in the Literature references field. See Literature reference. If the origin of the literature report is not clear, the "Other" option must be chosen. The option "Not available to sender" must not be used.

f.title: Each report has a single primary source for regulatory purposes
f.statement: The "Primary source for regulatory purposes" option must be enabled; where there are several sources, it is the person who first reported the facts to the sender, and each report must have only one primary source for regulatory purposes.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Primary source

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: habilitar necesariamente esta opción. La fuente principal de información es la persona que proporciona los hechos sobre el caso. En el caso de múltiples fuentes, la "Fuente primaria para fines regulatorios” es la persona que primero informó los hechos al remitente (sender). El reporte solo deberá tener una fuente primaria para fines regulatorios.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Primary source
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the contiguous passage so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: necessarily enable this option. The main source of information is the person who provides the facts about the case. In the case of multiple sources, the "Primary source for regulatory purposes" is the person who first reported the facts to the sender. The report shall have only one primary source for regulatory purposes.

f.title: Report medicines missing from the WHODrug catalogue using the C3 format and inform DINAVISA
f.statement: Where the WHODrug medicines catalogue is implemented and the medicine to be reported cannot be found in it, the holder must follow the steps in "How to use the WHODrug C3 format for coding medicines" and also send DINAVISA an e-mail with the same information sent to UMC.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Medicamento

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Cuando se implemente el catálogo de medicamentos WHODrug y no encuentre el medicamento específico que desea reportar a través de dicho catálogo, deberá seguir los pasos descritos en el documento “Cómo usar el formato WHODrug C3 para la codificación de medicamentos” y además enviar un correo electrónico a DINAVISA con la misma información enviada a UMC.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Medicamento
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When the WHODrug medicines catalogue is implemented and you cannot find the specific medicine you wish to report through that catalogue, you shall follow the steps described in the document "How to use the WHODrug C3 format for coding medicines" and also send an e-mail to DINAVISA with the same information sent to UMC.

f.title: Company causality assessment is optional; if given, follow internal procedures
f.statement: Causality assessment by the marketing authorisation holder is not a mandatory field; the holder may provide one using the WHO probabilistic categories or another method, established according to its internal procedures, and it is optional.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Assessment (Evaluación de causalidad)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: La evaluación de causalidad por parte de la empresa Titular de Registro Sanitario no es un campo obligatorio. La empresa Titular de Registro Sanitario podrá proporcionar una evaluación de causalidad utilizando las categorías probabilísticas de la OMS o algún otro método, cabe destacar que la evaluación de causalidad debe ser establecida acorde a procedimientos internos del Titular de Registro Sanitario y es de carácter opcional.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Assessment (Evaluación de causalidad)
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Causality assessment by the marketing authorisation holder is not a mandatory field. The holder may provide a causality assessment using the WHO probabilistic categories or another method; it should be noted that causality assessment must be established according to the holder's internal procedures and is optional.

f.title: Write the case narrative in the reporter's own words and describe other safety problems
f.statement: The case narrative must use the words and phrases of the initial/original reporter, keeping the original narrative; cite the clinical manifestations and the clinical diagnosis that led to the medication, then the signs and symptoms of the reaction; for congenital malformations, state the time in pregnancy; and for other safety problems (overdose, suspected falsification, misuse, abuse, medication error, off-label use, occupational exposure, etc.), describe the problem.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Case summaries

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Case narrative (Caso narrativo): deberá colocar la narrativa del caso con las palabras y frases utilizadas por el notificador inicial/original (tal cual fue notificado por éste), manteniendo la narrativa original. Citar las manifestaciones clínicas. Indicar el diagnóstico clínico de certeza y/o presuntivo que motivó la medicación y posteriormente los signos y síntomas de la reacción adversa. Si se detecta un efecto terapéutico no conocido hasta la fecha, puede indicarse en este espacio. En caso de tratarse de malformaciones congénitas, precise el momento del embarazo en que ocurrió el impacto. Si reporta otro problema de seguridad relacionado con el uso de medicamentos y vacunas, debe describir de qué problema se trata (sobredosis, sospecha de falsificación, mal uso, abuso, error de medicación, uso fuera de indicación, exposición ocupacional, entre otros).
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Case summaries
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the contiguous passage so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Case narrative: you shall enter the case narrative with the words and phrases used by the initial/original reporter (as reported by them), keeping the original narrative. Cite the clinical manifestations. Indicate the definitive and/or presumptive clinical diagnosis that led to the medication and then the signs and symptoms of the adverse reaction. If a therapeutic effect not known to date is detected, it may be indicated here. In the case of congenital malformations, specify the time in pregnancy when the impact occurred. If you report another safety problem related to the use of medicines and vaccines, you must describe what problem it is (overdose, suspected falsification, misuse, abuse, medication error, off-label use, occupational exposure, among others).

f.title: A case without the four minimum criteria cannot be notified
f.statement: A case that does not have the four minimum criteria cannot be notified; the system also flags the mandatory minimum fields (per ICH E2B) needed to send a case to the Pharmacovigilance Department.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Submit report (IMPORTANTE); 4.1-4.2 Preguntas frecuentes

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote:
4.1. ¿Puedo notificar un caso que no tenga los 4 criterios mínimos?

    No, adicionalmente el sistema indicará los campos mínimos obligatorios (conforme al estándar ICH-E2B) para poder
    enviar un caso al Dpto. de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Submit report (IMPORTANTE); 4.1-4.2 Preguntas frecuentes
rows.review_note: Review: the 3.9 IMPORTANTE box ("no debe ser enviada"; search for missing information first) is OCR-interleaved in two columns and cannot be quoted, so FAQ 4.1 is quoted and the statement is limited to what FAQ 4.1 says. Double-check: below 90 because the clearest wording is not quotable.
rows.quote_en: 4.1. Can I notify a case that does not have the 4 minimum criteria? No; in addition, the system will indicate the mandatory minimum fields (in accordance with the ICH-E2B standard) needed to send a case to the Pharmacovigilance Department.

f.title: Download and keep the XML of each manually entered report for follow-up
f.statement: After sending, the report XML must be downloaded and saved in the holder's backup, since it is needed to submit a follow-up of the case.
f.clause: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Download report; 4.18-4.19 Preguntas frecuentes
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Al oprimir Download, se descargará el archivo XML. Es importante que guarde este archivo en su respaldo, ya que deberá utilizarlo si requiere realizar un seguimiento del caso.
rows.location: 3.9. Módulo de carga manual — Download report; 4.18-4.19 Preguntas frecuentes
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When you press Download, the XML file will be downloaded. It is important that you save this file in your backup, since you will need to use it if you have to submit a follow-up of the case.

f.title: The ackLog must not be used to submit follow-up information
f.statement: For follow-up purposes, the ackLog file available in the Submission Status window must not be used; the downloaded report XML is loaded through "Edit report" instead.
f.clause: 3.10. Estado de envío y revisión de ackLogs (IMPORTANTE)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Hay que considerar que,para efectos de seguimiento, el archivo que corresponde al acuse (ackLog) disponible en la ventanaSubmissión Status NO deberá usarse para estepropósito.
rows.location: 3.10. Estado de envío y revisión de ackLogs (IMPORTANTE)
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: It should be considered that, for follow-up purposes, the file corresponding to the acknowledgement (ackLog) available in the Submission Status window shall NOT be used for this purpose.

f.title: Follow-ups of cases first sent on paper or ordinary e-Reporting go by e-mail until closed
f.statement: If a report was first notified through the paper notification form or the ordinary e-Reporting, its follow-ups until closure must be submitted by e-mail to the Pharmacovigilance Department.
f.clause: 4.4. Preguntas frecuentes

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Si un reporte se notificó inicialmente a través de la Ficha de notificación o e-Reporting ordinario, deberá someter los seguimientos hasta cerrarlo por correo electrónico a
rows.location: 4.4. Preguntas frecuentes

FAQ 4.16 says follow-ups of ordinary e-Reporting cases go through the same channel, which conflicts with this answer. Double-check: below 90 because of the conflict.
rows.quote_en: If a report was initially notified through the Notification Form or ordinary e-Reporting, you shall submit the follow-ups until it is closed by e-mail to

f.title: In clinical study reports, mark the study drug and blinded comparators as suspect
f.statement: Several suspect medicines may be added, but at least the study medicine and/or comparators in blinded studies must be marked as suspect.
f.clause: 4.12. Preguntas frecuentes
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular del Registro Sanitario) reporting to DINAVISA
rows.quote: Puede agregar más de un medicamento sospechoso pero el de estudio y/o comparadores en estudios cegados, deben marcarse como sospechosos al menos.
rows.location: 4.12. Preguntas frecuentes
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: You may add more than one suspect medicine, but the study medicine and/or comparators in blinded studies must be marked as suspect at least.

f.title: Protect passwords, do not share accounts, and report unauthorised use
f.statement: The e-Reporting Industria user is responsible for keeping their password confidential and for the consequences of not doing so; they must protect it and not share it, and if they know of unauthorised use of their account they must change the password immediately and inform the next hierarchical level.
f.clause: 5. Anexo A — Términos y condiciones de uso, Reglas de acceso y uso I

rows.actor: e-Reporting Industria user (marketing authorisation holder staff)
rows.quote: El usuario de e-Reporting Industria es responsable de mantener la confidencialidad de su contraseña y las consecuencias derivadas de no hacerlo así. Debe proteger su contraseña y no compartirla. Si sabe de un uso no autorizado de su cuenta, debe cambiar su contraseña de inmediato e informar al nivel jerárquico superior.
rows.location: 5. Anexo A — Términos y condiciones de uso, Reglas de acceso y uso I
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed so that it says only what the quote says. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The e-Reporting Industria user is responsible for keeping their password confidential and for the consequences of not doing so. They must protect their password and not share it. If they know of unauthorised use of their account, they must change their password immediately and inform the higher hierarchical level.
